::: {#exr-bikeshare-temp}

#### Rentals against temperature

The [`Bikeshare` data](#sec-bikeshare-lab) record the scaled temperature of each hour as `temp`,
and the number of bikes rented in that hour as `bikers`.
A [scatterplot](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-scatterplot) shows how the counts change with a numerical [covariate](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate).

::: {.callout-tip}

#### Hint

`ggplot2::geom_point()` in R, `plot()` in base R, and `ax.scatter()` from matplotlib in Python draw a [scatterplot](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-scatterplot).

:::

Draw a [scatterplot](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-scatterplot) of `bikers` against `temp`.

:::
